title: Eleven Houses, the Same Week in May
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（自然科学·科学精神与探索）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（自然科学·科学精神与探索）　|　核心词汇：theory　|　正文 361 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 theory 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My grandfather had a ① theory that the swifts came back to the same eleven houses every year, and he was right, and it took him thirty-one years to prove it and nobody ever wrote it down. He was not a scientist. He was a postman, and he said the ② theory of a thing is only the shape you give to thirty-one years of looking.

He did not believe in the ③ theory of evolution, which in 1961 was not unusual in a village, and he did not disbelieve it either; he said he had not looked for thirty-one years and therefore had no opinion, and that a theory without thirty-one years behind it is only an opinion with a longer name. His ④ theory, as distinct from his practice, was that you look; his practice was that he looked, every evening at six, from the same chair, for thirty-one years.

⑤ In theory, he said, anybody can do what I have done, and I have never met anybody who did. The ⑥ theory he arrived at — eleven houses, eleven pairs, the same week in May — was published by somebody else in 1974, four hundred miles away, with eleven years of data behind it, and the theory was not new when it was printed. My grandfather read the paper, said the man had got the week right and the houses wrong, and went back to his chair.

I ⑦ have a theory that he minded, though he never said so; the ⑧ theory of everything, as he called it, was not the swifts at all but the question of whether being right is the same as having been right first. He said it was not, and he said it more than once, which is how you can tell that a person has not settled it.

The ⑨ theory, meaning the eleven houses and the week in May, was finally written up by a woman from the university in 1998, eleven years after he died, and she put his name in the second footnote. My mother had the page framed. The ⑩ theory I have, and it is only a theory, is that he would have preferred the birds.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 理论；学说；原理
B. n. 推测；揣测；个人的推断
C. n. （与“实践”相对的）理论；道理
D. 固定搭配：in theory 理论上；按理说
E. 固定搭配：the theory of ... ……的理论／道理
F. 固定搭配：theory of evolution 进化论
G. 固定搭配：have a theory that ... 有一种推测：……
H. 固定搭配：a theory of everything 万物理论；统一理论

items.q: had a theory that the swifts came back
the theory of a thing is only the shape
the theory of evolution, which in 1961
His theory, as distinct from his practice
In theory, he said, anybody can do
I have a theory that he minded
the theory of everything, as he called it
The theory, meaning the eleven houses
The theory I have, and it is only a theory

answers.why: a theory 意为“推测、个人的推断”，祖父有一种推测：雨燕每年回到同样的十一户人家。
the theory of a thing 意为“一件事物的道理、理论”，他说一件事物的道理不外乎是你给三十一年观察所取的形状。
the theory of evolution 意为“进化论”，1961 年的村子里不相信进化论并不稀奇。
his theory ... as distinct from his practice 意为“他的理论（与实践相对）”，他的理论是“你去观察”，他的实践是他真的每天六点坐在同一把椅子上看。
in theory 意为“理论上、按理说”，他说按理说任何人都能做到我做到的事。
the theory 意为“（得出的）理论、结论”，他得出的结论是十一户人家、十一对、五月同一周。
have a theory that ... 意为“有一种推测：……”，我有一种推测：他其实是在意的，虽然他从未说过。
a theory of everything 意为“万物理论、统一理论”，他说的“万物理论”根本不是雨燕，而是“正确”与“最先正确”是否同一回事。
the theory 意为“那套理论、学说”，指十一户人家和五月那一周，1998 年终于被人写成论文。
a theory 意为“推测”，我自己的一种推测——仅仅是推测——是他宁愿要那些鸟。
